……まだ、早い。
どんな状態なのか把握してもいないのに仕掛けるのは無謀すぎる。

pages.en:
“————”

I silence my breathing.

Pressing close to the wall, I conceal myself and watch.

…Not yet.

It would be madness to attack before I even understand the situation.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
I breathe quietly.
I push my body against the wall and watch while keeping myself hidden.
…It’s still too early.
It’ll be too reckless to charge in when I don’t understand the situation yet.

pages.ja:
なにより持ち札はあまりに少ない。
武器は強化した木刀だけ。それだけの武器で、策もなくキャスターと対峙するのは無謀すぎる。
いや、違う。
武器なら、他にもう一つあった筈だ。

pages.en:
Above all, I have far too few cards to play.

My only weapon is a Reinforced wooden sword. To confront Caster with nothing more and no plan would be sheer suicide.

——No. That isn't true.

There should be one other weapon available to me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And more than anything, I don’t have much power.
The strengthened wooden sword is my only weapon. It’s foolish to confront Caster without a plan.
No, that’s wrong.
I do have another weapon.

pages.ja:
「…………馬鹿な。それこそ、何を考えている」
投影なんて使えない。
一度やっただけで体の半分が麻痺したんだ。
アーチャーも言っていただろう、次に使えば麻痺だけでは済まないと。
pages.jaRuby:
「…………馬鹿な。それこそ、何を考えている」

pages.en:
“…………Don't be stupid. What the hell are you thinking?”

I cannot use Projection.

Using it once paralyzed half my body.

Archer warned me himself: the next attempt would cost me more than paralysis.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……No way. What am I thinking?”
I can’t use projection.
Half my body became numb after I used it once.
Archer told me that it’ll end up worse if I do it again.

pages.ja:
自らの力量を超えた魔術は、まず術者を駆逐する。
今の体で身に余る投影魔術なんて使えば、その場で死んでもおかしくない。
「
機会は必ず来る。今は」
駆け出したくなる体を抑えて、その機会に備えるだけだ。

pages.en:
Magecraft beyond the practitioner's ability destroys the practitioner first.

If I attempt a Projection far beyond the limits of this wounded body, I may die on the spot.

“——An opportunity will come. For now…”

I suppress the urge to rush forward and prepare myself to seize that moment.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Using magic beyond your capabilities can destroy you.
If I use projection magic in this state, it’ll be natural for me to die on the spot.
“The chance will come. For now…”
I’ll bide my time and wait for my chance.

pages.ja:
「
そう。なら綺礼は殺したわけ？」
張り詰めた声には殺気しかない。
遠坂は今までにない冷たさで、目前の敵を睨んでいた。
pages.jaRuby:
「
そう。なら綺礼は殺したわけ？」
張り詰めた声には殺気しかない。
遠坂は今までにない冷たさで、目前の敵を睨んでいた。
pages.en:
“——I see. Then you killed Kirei?”

Her taut voice contains nothing but murderous intent.

Tohsaka regards the enemy before her with a coldness I have never seen in her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. So you killed Kirei?”
Her voice only holds murderous intent.
Tohsaka is glaring at the enemy with a coldness I’ve never seen before.

pages.ja:
「ええ、始末したわ。素直に聖杯を差し出す人間でもなさそうでしたからね。後々になって邪魔をされても困るもの」
対して、キャスターには余裕がある。
魔女は高らかに、神父をその手に掛けたと宣言した。
pages.jaRuby:
「ええ、始末したわ。素直に聖杯を差し出す人間でもなさそうでしたからね。後々になって邪魔をされても困るもの」
対して、キャスターには余裕がある。
魔女は高らかに、神父をその手に掛けたと宣言した。
pages.en:
“Yes. I disposed of him. He did not seem likely to surrender the Holy Grail willingly, and I could hardly allow him to interfere with me later.”

Caster, by contrast, is utterly at ease.

The witch proudly declares that she killed the priest with her own hands.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yes. He didn’t seem like someone that would obediently hand me the Holy Grail. I also didn’t want him to interrupt later on.”
In contrast, Caster is calm and composed.
The magus in purple cheerfully admits the murder of the priest.

pages.ja:
「
」
ぎり、という音が聖堂に響く。
……俺にとっては聖者というよりは悪魔めいた男だったが、遠坂にとって、あの神父は兄弟子だった。
それを殺されたのだ。
どんなに魔術師として覚悟していて、あの神父もこちら側の人間だったとしても、簡単に受け流せる事じゃない。

pages.en:
“————”

The sound of grinding teeth echoes through the sanctuary.

…To me, the man was more devil than saint. But to Tohsaka, that priest had trained beside her as her senior.

Now he has been killed.

However prepared she may be as a mage, however deeply the priest belonged to this side of the world, that is not something she can simply dismiss.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
A gritting sound echoes through the temple.
…He was more like a devil than a saint to me, but that priest was a fellow apprentice to Tohsaka.
And he was killed.
Even though he was involved and might have been prepared for it, it’s not something she can take in readily.

pages.ja: 「……そう。それは結構。綺礼もそれぐらいは覚悟していたでしょう。けどキャスター。一つ訊くけど、あいつの死体は確認した？」
pages.jaRuby: 「……そう。それは結構。綺礼もそれぐらいは覚悟していたでしょう。けどキャスター。一つ訊くけど、あいつの死体は確認した？」
pages.en: “…I see. Splendid. Kirei must have been prepared for that much. But one question, Caster. Did you confirm his corpse?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “…I see. That’s fine. Kirei should have been prepared for such a thing. But Caster. Did you check his corpse?”

pages.ja:
怒りを押しとどめたのか、それとも俺の勝手な思い違いで、初めから怒りなどなかったのか。
遠坂は他人事のように問いただし、キャスターは一転して言葉を濁す。
pages.jaRuby:
怒りを押しとどめたのか、それとも俺の勝手な思い違いで、初めから怒りなどなかったのか。
遠坂は他人事のように問いただし、キャスターは一転して言葉を濁す。
pages.en:
Perhaps she has mastered her anger. Or perhaps I imagined it, and she felt none from the beginning.

Tohsaka questions her as though the matter concerned someone else. For the first time, Caster's answer becomes evasive.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Am I mistaken, or has she suppressed all her anger? Tohsaka seems like she’s not angry at all.
Caster evades Tohsaka’s question.

pages.ja: 「……何を言いだすかと思えば。そのような事、貴女には関係ないでしょう」
pages.jaRuby: 「……何を言いだすかと思えば。そのような事、貴女には関係ないでしょう」
pages.en: “…What a peculiar question. That has nothing to do with you.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “…What are you saying? Such a thing should not concern you.”

pages.ja:
「ええ、まったくないわ。けど他人事でもない。あいつが本当に死んだんなら安心できるから、確認しただけよ」
「
それはどういう意味かしら、お嬢さん」
pages.jaRuby:
「ええ、まったくないわ。けど他人事でもない。あいつが本当に死んだんなら安心できるから、確認しただけよ」
「
それはどういう意味かしら、お嬢さん」
pages.en:
“No, nothing whatsoever. But that doesn't make it someone else's problem. I only asked because if he's truly dead, I can stop worrying.”

“——What precisely do you mean by that, young lady?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“No, it doesn’t. But it’s not something totally unrelated to me. I just wanted to make sure, since I’ll be relieved if he’s really dead.”
“What does that mean, little lady?”

pages.ja:
「言葉通りの意味よキャスター。
あいつがそう簡単に死ぬタマかっての。もしはっきりと死体を確認していないんじゃ、まず間違いなく生きてるって思っただけ」
pages.jaRuby:
「言葉通りの意味よキャスター。
あいつがそう簡単に死ぬタマかっての。もしはっきりと死体を確認していないんじゃ、まず間違いなく生きてるって思っただけ」
pages.en:
“Exactly what I said, Caster.

“Kirei isn't the sort of creature who dies that easily. If you didn't see a corpse beyond all doubt, then I assume he's almost certainly alive.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It means what it means, Caster.
He’s not one to die so easily. I just thought he might be alive, since you didn’t check the corpse.”

pages.ja:
「ち。使えないわね、貴女も。どうせ綺礼を襲うならしっかりきっかり息の根を止めておけっていうのよ。
まあいいわ。やる事も出来たし、早めに済ませましょうキャスター。今回は人質もいないし、気持ちよく戦えるわ」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Tch. You're useless too. If you were going to attack Kirei, you should at least have made absolutely certain he stopped breathing.

“Never mind. Now I have another task to deal with. Let's settle this quickly, Caster. There are no hostages this time, so we can enjoy a clean fight.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Damn, you’re useless. If you attacked Kirei, make sure you killed him.
Oh well. I have something to do now, so let’s finish this quickly, Caster. We can fight freely, as there are no hostages this time.”

開始の合図。
遠坂かキャスター。

——The signal to begin.

Tohsaka or Caster.

The instant either takes one step forward, the sanctuary will be swallowed by the flames of magecraft—
pages.mirrorMoon:
A signal to start.
Tohsaka or Caster…
If either one of them takes a step forward, this temple will be filled with magic

pages.ja: 「大きくでたわね。貴女、この状況で私たちに勝てるつもりなのかしら」
pages.jaRuby: 「大きくでたわね。貴女、この状況で私たちに勝てるつもりなのかしら」
pages.en: “Bold words. Do you truly imagine you can defeat us under these conditions?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “You talk big. Do you think you can beat me in this situation?”

pages.ja:
「やりようによってはね。幸いセイバーの制御もまだのようだし、条件は同じでしょう。
それに葛木先生の事も判ってる。セイバーは面食らってたけど、事前に知っていれば私のアーチャーの敵じゃないわ」
キャスターを見据えながら、遠坂はアーチャーに手をかざす。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“With the right approach. Fortunately, it seems you still haven't brought Saber under control, so our circumstances are equal.

“And I know about Mr. Kuzuki now. Saber was taken by surprise, but once my Archer knows what to expect, that man is no match for him.”

Without taking her eyes from Caster, Tohsaka raises a hand toward Archer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It depends on how I do it. Fortunately, it seems Saber has yet to come under your control, so the conditions are the same.
And I also know about Kuzuki-sensei. Saber was surprised, but he’s no threat to Archer if he knows his attacks beforehand.”
Tohsaka points to Archer while staring at Caster.

pages.ja:
「聞いての通りよアーチャー。
キャスターの相手はわたしがする。下手に近づくとアンタまで契約破りをくらいかねないから」
「……ふむ。私の相手はあの男か。
それは構わないが
魔術師ではキャスターには敵わないと解っているのか、凛」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“You heard me, Archer.

“I'll handle Caster. If you approach her carelessly, you might have your own contract broken.”

“…Hm. Then that man is my opponent.

“I have no objection, but do you understand that a mage cannot defeat Caster, Rin?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You heard it, Archer.
I’ll fight Caster. She might break your contract if you get too close to her.”
“…Hm. So I will be fighting that man?
I do not mind, butdo you know that a magus cannot beat Caster, Rin?”

pages.ja:
「……安心して、勝ち目もない事は言いださないわ。
キャスターは必ずここで倒す。そうすればセイバーだって元に戻って、士郎と契約をし直せるでしょ」
遠坂の腰がわずかに落ちる。
獲物に襲いかかる猫科の猛獣を思わせる緊迫感。
pages.jaRuby:
「……安心して、勝ち目もない事は言いださないわ。

遠坂の腰がわずかに落ちる。
獲物に襲いかかる猫科の猛獣を思わせる緊迫感。
pages.en:
“…Don't worry. I wouldn't propose it if I saw no path to victory.

“Caster dies here. Once she does, Saber should return to herself and be able to renew her contract with Shirou.”

——Tohsaka lowers her center of gravity slightly.

The tension recalls a great cat poised to spring upon its prey.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Don’t worry. I wouldn’t say anything if I didn’t have a chance of victory.
I’ll surely defeat Caster here. If I do that, Saber will be freed and Shirou can make a contract with her again, right?”
Tohsaka tenses for action.
I feel pressure as if she’s a tiger about to attack its prey.

pages.ja:
それを止めるように、
「理想論だな。彼女をここで倒す、というのは難しい。
逃げるだけならば彼女は当代一だ。なにしろ逃亡の為に、実の弟すら八つ裂きにする女だからな」
無造作に、アーチャーが遠坂とキャスターの間に立った。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
As though to stop her—

“An idealistic plan. Defeating her here will not be easy.

“When it comes to flight, she has no peer in this age. She is a woman who tore even her own brother limb from limb to escape.”

Archer steps casually between Tohsaka and Caster.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And as if to stop her…
“That is only in theory. It is difficult to defeat her here.
She is a master when it comes to running away. She is a woman that will kill her own brother to escape.”
Archer steps in between Tohsaka and Caster.

pages.ja:
「アーチャー……？ ちょっと、なんのつもりよ」
「
」
遠坂の声にも答えない。
赤い騎士はいつかのように、無言でキャスターと対峙する。
pages.jaRuby:
「アーチャー……？ ちょっと、なんのつもりよ」

」

pages.en:
“Archer…? Wait, what do you think you're doing?”

“————”

He does not answer Tohsaka.

Just as he did once before, the knight in red silently faces Caster.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Archer…? What are you doing?”
“”
He does not answer Tohsaka.
The knight in red silently confronts Caster.

pages.ja:
そんな光景を。
いつか、見た覚えが、あった。
pages.jaRuby:
そんな光景を。
いつか、見た覚えが、あった。
pages.en:
This sight.

I remember seeing it before.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I think…
I saw something like this before…

pages.ja:
「……実の弟すら八つ裂きにした、ですって……？
知ったような口をきくのねアーチャー。アナタには私の正体が判っていて？」
pages.jaRuby:
「……実の弟すら八つ裂きにした、ですって……？
知ったような口をきくのねアーチャー。アナタには私の正体が判っていて？」
pages.en:
“…You say I tore my own brother limb from limb…?

“You speak as though you know me, Archer. Have you discerned my true identity?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I killed my own brother…?
You talk like you know about me. Do you know my true identity?”

pages.ja:
「竜の歯を依り代とした人型はコルキス王の魔術と聞く。
その娘、王女メディアは稀代の魔女と謳われたそうだが？」
空気が凍る。
キャスターから余裕が消え、火のような敵意がアーチャーへ叩きつけられる。
pages.jaRuby:

空気が凍る。

pages.en:
“I have heard that human figures fashioned around dragon's teeth belong to the magecraft of the King of Colchis.

“And was his daughter, the princess Medea, not celebrated as the greatest witch of her age?”

——The air freezes.

Caster's composure vanishes. Hostility like flame lashes against Archer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I hear human-shaped creatures made of dragon’s teeth are magic used by the king of Colchis.
I hear that his daughter, Medea, was famed as an excellent witch.”
The air freezes.
Caster’s composure disappears and enmity like fire is directed at Archer.

pages.ja:
「
そう。
なら、この場はどちらが優勢か判るでしょう？」
「
」
アーチャーは答えない。
善悪などないと。ただ物事を受け入れるだけの、岩のようなその表情。
pages.jaRuby:
「

」

pages.en:
“——I see.

“Then you must understand which of us holds the advantage here.”

“————”

Archer does not answer.

His face is stone, accepting the facts without judgment of good or evil.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see.
Then you should know which one of us is at an advantage now, right?”
“”
Archer does not answer.
His expression is like stone, as if accepting everything that is happening.

pages.ja:
「抵抗は無駄よアーチャー。
貴方が何者だろうと、セイバーを取り戻す事はできない。今はまだ私に逆らう意思が残ってるけど、それもあと一日保つかどうか。
それに
令呪さえ使ってしまえば、今すぐにだって私の人形にしてしまえるわ」

令呪さえ使ってしまえば、今すぐにだって私の人形にしてしまえるわ」
pages.en:
“Resistance is useless, Archer.

“Whoever you may be, you cannot recover Saber. For now, she still possesses the will to oppose me—but I doubt it will survive another day.

“Besides——the moment I use a Command Spell, I can turn her into my puppet.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Resistance is futile, Archer.
You won’t be able to take back Saber no matter who you may be. She still has a will to resist me, but that should not last for another day.
AndI can make her into my puppet now if I use my Command Spell.”

」
立ち上がろうとする足を押さえつける。

セイバーを助けたいんなら、ここで飛び出す訳にはいかない

“————”

I force down the legs that threaten to rise beneath me.

…Not yet.

Even if she speaks the truth, I have to endure.

If I want to save Saber, I cannot reveal myself here—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I barely stop myself from moving.
…Not yet.
Even if that’s true, now’s not the time.
If I want to save Saber, I can’t jump out now

But we should be able to beat you in that time.”

pages.en:
“Impossible. Even if I cut you down here, at best I would sever half your body.

“What followed would leave us at a hopeless disadvantage, facing Saber and Caster together.”

With those words, he denies the plan of Tohsaka, his own Master.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That is impossible. Even if we attack you, all we would manage is to take half your powers at most.
What awaits us after that is a disadvantageous situation where we would be fighting both you and Saber.”
…Archer does not meet his Master’s expectations.

pages.ja:
「アーチャー、それは」
「判っている筈だ、凛。流石にそうなっては勝ち目がない。
セイバーは不完全なマスターの為に能力を制限されていた。その縛りがなくなった以上、彼女は最強のサーヴァントだ。太刀打ちできるのはバーサーカーのみだろうよ」
pages.jaRuby:
「アーチャー、それは」

pages.en:
“Archer, what are you——”

“You know this, Rin. Even we could not win once matters came to that.

“An inadequate Master restricted Saber's abilities. Now that those restraints are gone, she is the strongest Servant. Berserker alone might stand against her.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Archer, that’s…”
“You should know, Rin. We cannot win if that happens.
Saber’s abilities were restricted because of her incomplete Master. As she does not have that restriction anymore, she is the strongest Servant now. Only Berserker should be able to match her.”

pages.ja:
淡々と語る。
遠坂はアーチャーを呆然と見つめ、

He speaks without emotion.

Tohsaka stares at Archer in disbelief.

Even Caster seems unsettled by an enemy so quick to understand.
pages.mirrorMoon:
He speaks plainly.
Tohsaka stares at Archer in astonishment,
and even Caster is bewildered by the sensible enemy.

pages.jaRuby:

But not me.

I have already lived through a scene much like this one.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But it’s different for me.
I’ve experienced something like this before.

あの時の境内。

pages.en:
“No——that bastard…”

A terrible premonition smothers every other thought.

That day in the temple grounds.

When Caster confronted him and offered him a place at her side, how did he refuse her?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Could he…?”
I get a bad feeling.
Back at the Ryuudou Temple…
When Caster proposed that he join her, what did he say back to her when he refused?

The word escapes me.

Don't do that.

Not because it will make the situation worse.

You are Tohsaka's partner.

So don't.

If you do such a thing——I no longer know what expression she will make.

Don’t do it.
It’s not because the situation will get worse.
You’re Tohsaka’s partner.
So don’t do it.

Magical energy that allows her to maintain seven Servants.
It is the lives of the people in this town.

go crazy.

That the hero who saved so many people, the very embodiment of Shirou Emiya's ideal, could be a man like this—
pages.mirrorMoon:
A hero.
For this hero, who embodies Emiya Shirou’s ideals, to do such a thing

pages.en: “After refusing me then? How quick you are to change your tune, Archer.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Even though you refused back then? You are pretty unfaithful.”

pages.ja:
「状況が変わった。
セイバーがそちらについたのなら、今回の聖杯戦争の勝機はおまえにある。勝てる方につくのは当然の行為だろう」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Circumstances have changed.

“Now that Saber stands with you, you have the best chance of winning this Holy Grail War. It is only natural to join the side that will prevail.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“The situation has changed.
If Saber is on your side now, you are likely to win the Holy Grail War. It is natural to want to be on the winning side, right?”

pages.ja:
アーチャーは無防備なままキャスターへと歩いていく。
それは遠坂から離れるという事だ。
遠坂は止めず、油断なく目前の敵を見据えていた。

Utterly defenseless, Archer walks toward Caster.

Each step carries him farther from Tohsaka.

She makes no attempt to stop him. Her eyes remain warily fixed upon the enemy before her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Archer walks towards Caster defenselessly.
That means he’s abandoning Tohsaka.
Tohsaka does not stop him and stares at her enemy.

I know that figure.

The crimson classroom.

Standing before her fallen classmates, Tohsaka concealed the trembling of her legs and continued to be Rin Tohsaka.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I know that figure.
The red classroom.
She tried to hide her trembling legs and act like the same old Tohsaka Rin, even with the collapsed students in front of her.

どんな時でも気丈であろうとするから、周りの人間は、あいつを強い人間だと勘違いしてしまう

pages.en:
…That is both her strength and her weakness.

Because she stands proud no matter what happens, everyone around her mistakes her for someone who cannot be hurt—

…That’s her strength and weakness.
She tries to act firm in any situation, so everybody around her gets the wrong idea that she’s a strong person

His flippancy has not changed.

He has betrayed Tohsaka before her own eyes, yet carries on exactly as he did before.

Perhaps that is why Caster remains suspicious.

She produces the grotesque dagger, but does not drive it into Archer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
His tone doesn’t change.
He betrayed Tohsaka in front of her, but he’s still acting normally.
She must be on guard against such a guy.
Caster takes out the distorted dagger, but she does not pierce Archer with it.

“What? You’ll obtain a loyal subordinate without trouble.
Why do you need to hesitate?”
“…Really? I do not trust betrayers. If your words are correct, then shouldn’t Saber be enough for me?”

“Command Spells exist to punish traitors, do they not?

“…Very well. If I cannot control even one such as you, then my own limitations will be plain. I have long been curious about your Noble Phantasm, in any case. I shall indulge whatever scheme you have devised.”

“The Command Spell is there to punish the betrayer, right?
…All right. I shall prove to the world that I am great enough to take you in. I am interested in your Noble Phantasm, so I will follow your plan.”

pages.en:
Caster raises her arm.

The contract-breaking dagger in her hand drives straight into Archer's chest.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Caster raises her arm.
The dagger to eliminate the contract pierces Archer’s chest.

pages.ja:
「っ
！」
遠坂の顔が歪む。
一方的に契約が断ち切られた事による反動だろう。
だが、そんな事に躊躇しているあいつじゃない。
状況は、ここにきて最悪な物となった。

pages.en:
“——!”

Tohsaka's face twists.

It is probably the backlash from having their contract severed by force.

But she is not someone who will falter over that.

The situation has now reached its worst possible state.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
Tohsaka makes a pained face.
It must be the reaction of having her contract broken by force.
But this isn’t the time to be hesitating.
This has become the worst possible situation.

pages.ja:
遠坂はキャスターたちを見据えたまま、じり、と僅かに後退している。
……遠坂は冷静だ。
もう、この場は戦ってどうにかなる状況ではないと理解している。
それでもまだ戦うというのなら、今は撤退するしかない。
pages.jaRuby:
遠坂はキャスターたちを見据えたまま、じり、と僅かに後退している。
……遠坂は冷静だ。
もう、この場は戦ってどうにかなる状況ではないと理解している。
それでもまだ戦うというのなら、今は撤退するしかない。
pages.en:
Still facing Caster and the others, Tohsaka gives a single, measured step backward.

…She is calm.

She understands that fighting can no longer resolve anything here.

If she still means to continue the battle, retreat is her only move now.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Tohsaka watches Caster and slowly retreats.
…Tohsaka’s calm.
She knows it’d do no good to fight them now.
If she wants to keep on fighting, she has to retreat for the moment.

pages.ja:
「
」
だが、遠坂の位置から階段まで六メートル。
その距離を一気に走り抜ける事など出来るのか。
pages.jaRuby:
「
」
だが、遠坂の位置から階段まで六メートル。
その距離を一気に走り抜ける事など出来るのか。
pages.en:
“————”

But six meters lie between Tohsaka and the stairs.

Can she possibly cross that distance in a single rush?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
But there are six meters between Tohsaka and the stairs.
Is it possible for her to run that distance safely?

pages.ja:
不可能だ。
こうして上から見れば瞭然としている。
今まで終始無言だった葛木が、遠坂に意識を向けている。
遠坂が背中を見せて全力疾走したところで、あの葛木を躱して階段に辿り着き、この出口まで上りきる事が出来るというのか。
pages.jaRuby:
不可能だ。
こうして上から見れば瞭然としている。
今まで終始無言だった葛木が、遠坂に意識を向けている。
遠坂が背中を見せて全力疾走したところで、あの葛木を躱して階段に辿り着き、この出口まで上りきる事が出来るというのか。
pages.en:
——No.

From my vantage point, it is obvious.

Kuzuki, silent until now, has focused his attention upon Tohsaka.

Even if she turns her back and sprints with all her strength, can she evade him, reach the stairs, and climb all the way to this exit?
pages.mirrorMoon:
Impossible.
It’s apparent, watching the scene from above.
Kuzuki, who has been silent up to now, is on guard against Tohsaka.
If she turns and runs full-speed, would she be able to reach the stairs and get to the exit before Kuzuki catches up to her?

pages.ja:
キャスターたちを見据えたまま、遠坂は鼻を鳴らす。
その顔が、
“ふん
そんなの無理に決まってるじゃない”
そう、皮肉げに呟いているように見えた。

pages.en:
Without taking her eyes from Caster and the others, Tohsaka snorts.

Her expression seems to mutter sarcastically,

*Hmph. Of course that's impossible.*
pages.mirrorMoon:
Tohsaka sighs while looking at them.
Her face…
‘Hehthat’s impossible.’
…Seems to say so.

このままならあいつは殺される。
それを助けるというのなら、俺も戻る事はできなくなる。

“————”

She will die.

If nothing changes, she will be killed.

If I act to save her, I will not return either.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
She’ll die.
She’ll be killed.
If I try to help her, I will also die.

pages.ja:
この下、僅かでも階段を下りた場所は死地だ。
葛木というマスターと敵であるサーヴァントが二人。
それを前にして、生きて帰れる筈がない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
The instant I descend even one step farther, everything below becomes a place of death.

One Master—Mr. Kuzuki—and two enemy Servants.

No one could face them and expect to leave alive.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The area below me is a land of death.
There is a Master called Kuzuki along with two enemy Servants.
There’s no way I’d get out of there alive.

指は緊張で固まったまま。
ゼロかイチか。
それを、思案する時間もなく、
遠坂の体が流れた。

pages.en:
“————”

My throat is dry.

Tension has locked my fingers in place.

Zero or one.

Before I have any time to weigh the choice,

Tohsaka's body flows into motion.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
My throat is dry.
My fingers are tense from nervousness.
Zero or one?
Even before I can think…
Tohsaka moves.

pages.ja:
なんの前触れもなく、矢のような速さで階段へと走り出す。
その背中に。
遠坂が止まって見える速度で、痩身の影が追い付いていた。
pages.jaRuby:
なんの前触れもなく、矢のような速さで階段へと走り出す。

pages.en:
Without warning, she races toward the stairs with the speed of an arrow.

A slender shadow overtakes her from behind,

moving so fast that Tohsaka appears to have stopped.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She starts for the stairs without any warning.
Behind her…
A tall lean figure catches up to her so quickly that Tohsaka appears to be standing still.

pages.en:
Kuzuki's fist will strike the back of her skull.

This is the man who wounded Saber through her armor.

A human skull would scarcely be worth the effort of breaking.

“————”

——I cannot save her.

Alone, I cannot help her.

This wooden sword cannot save her.

He was able to hurt Saber through her armor.
It should be easy for him to break a human skull.

I can’t save her with this wooden sword.
